quotes.quote: Pisces is the last of the four Mutable signs—Mutable Water.
Spiritually, the Pisces lifetime is about dissolving of attachment without losing contact with feelings of kindness and compassion.
As the cosmic ocean of infinity, it is boundless and universal, for as William Blake wrote, “Who shall bind the Infinite?”
Astrologically, Pisces is the sign of the actor or the chameleon

quotes.quote: Though our modern zodiac represents Pisces as two fish swimming in opposite directions, through the ages many cultures chose the dolphin to symbolize Pisces.
Dionysius, the Divine Child, Zeus’ wife Hera became jealous
This is what I mean by Piscean absolutism.
Dionysius was timid, fearful and hypersensitive as a child.
